scope: Fresh supervisor BSLOT=11 BGRID=1, 30 s, hidden 8K, all features on except FPS; each completed candidate measured once
limitations: Per-interval GetThreadTimes is quantized; use whole-window mean.
QueryThreadCycleTime is not a fixed-frequency duration conversion.
Eight worst intervals supply only 132 samples; do not treat small percentage differences as precise attribution.
Single completed-candidate runs, not isolated repeated A/B tests.
